title: Oven Roasted Italian Savoy Cabbage Amatriciana
description: A plant-based Italian dish featuring roasted Savoy cabbage and a cheese-pull effect, inspired by the flavors of Tuscan cuisine, with a bhuna twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the Savoy cabbage leaves with olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the cabbage leaves in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
In a large skillet, cook the diced vegan bacon over medium heat until crispy, then set aside.
In the same skillet, cook the chopped onion and minced garlic until the onion is translucent.
Add the tomato paste to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the nutritional yeast and cook for an additional minute.
To assemble the dish, place a layer of roasted cabbage leaves in a baking dish, followed by a layer of the tomato paste mixture and a sprinkle of vegan mozzarella shreds.
Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of mozzarella shreds on top.
Return the dish to the oven and bake until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
